# ITSolvez

> ITSolvez is an ISO 9001:2015, ISO 27001:2022 and ISO 20000-1:2018 certified software development and IT services company headquartered in Mumbai, India, serving clients across India, the UAE, UK, USA, Singapore and Australia. Core services: custom software development, web development & design, mobile app development (Flutter, React Native, native iOS/Android), managed IT services, cloud computing (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), IT staff augmentation, ERP/CRM/HRMS systems and digital marketing.

Key facts:
- Founded in Mumbai; Udyam-registered (UDYAM-MH-19-0440563); 8+ years in business, 300+ projects delivered, 120+ clients, 5+ countries served.
- ISO certificates issued by Anglia Compliance Group, UK — verifiable at https://www.angliacompliance.uk/verify-certificate (cert nos. 25-07-21156543, 25-07-21156544, 25-07-21156545), valid until 9 July 2029.
- Contact: info@itsolvez.com · +91 9967470207 · https://itsolvez.com/contact

## Services
- [Custom Software Development](https://itsolvez.com/services/custom-software): Bespoke business software, ERP, CRM, HRMS — discovery-first, fixed-scope delivery.
- [Web Development](https://itsolvez.com/services/web-development): High-performance, SEO-architected websites and web applications.
- [App Development](https://itsolvez.com/services/app-development): iOS, Android, Flutter and React Native apps from MVP to enterprise.
- [Managed IT Services](https://itsolvez.com/services/managed-it): 24/7 monitoring and support with 15-minute critical response SLAs.
- [Cloud Computing](https://itsolvez.com/services/cloud-computing): AWS, Azure and Google Cloud migration and management.
- [IT Staff Augmentation](https://itsolvez.com/services/it-staff-augmentation): Vetted engineers embedded in your team.
- [All services](https://itsolvez.com/services)
